assertion.rationale: F7: environment:demo federates to the deployer and grants it Owner on the subscription, and the demo environment has no deployment-branch policy, so an Owner-capable OIDC subject is mintable from any ref by anything executing in a verify job. F8: the deployer service principal holds Application.ReadWrite.All when apply-entra.ps1 only creates and updates three apps it owns, so the actual privilege needed is Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy — a strictly narrower grant. F13: privilege across the estate is inverted — Owner and ReadWrite.All exist where automation is fully automated, while seven documented least-privilege workload grants (data-api, mcp-tools, cost-ingest) exist nowhere in code.

recommendation: Federate a distinct verify environment to mls-verifier, with deployment-branch policy restricting both demo and verify to main. Swap Application.ReadWrite.All for Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy on the deployer. Set roleDefinitionIds: [] on the NIST policy identity — the identity still gets created and the assignment still validates. Express the seven documented workload RBAC grants in IaC.
